artworks.title: Charles Emmanuel, Prince of Piedmont
artworks.description: The image shows a man riding a horse, dressed in armor, holding a baton. He is surrounded by soldiers, mountains, a city, and various symbols. In the foreground, a figure lies on the ground with an open book.

artworks.title: Pierre Charron, French Philosopher
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting the upper body of a man in a portrait frame. The man is positioned facing slightly to his right with his gaze directed towards the viewer. He has a high forehead and receding hairline, with short hair on the sides and a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. His facial features convey a mature appearance, with a furrowed brow above small, intelligent eyes and a slightly pursed mouth. He is dressed in a traditional 17th-century garment, featuring a large collar and a series of buttons running down the front. The background is detailed with foliage designs along the frame, which includes textual elements stating "Pierre Charron" and other information. The image borders are filled with text in French.

artworks.title: The Progenie of Geffrey Chaucer
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright, looking to his left. He has a beard, mustache, and medium-length hair covered by a cap or hood. He wears a long robe, full sleeves, and slipper-like shoes. In his left hand, he holds beads, and his right hand is on his chest. Surrounding him are various heraldic shields and family crests arranged in a genealogical layout with connecting lines. The background is plain, highlighting the shields, crests, and intricate design work. Inscriptions detail the genealogy and identify the man as Geoffrey Chaucer.

artworks.title: Sir John Cheke, Tutor to Edward VI
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a man seated inside an oval frame. He has distinctive facial features including a straight nose, narrow eyes, and high cheekbones. He has a long beard and short hair covered with a cap. He wears elaborate attire with fur details on the collar, indicating wealth. A chain with a large pendant hangs around his neck. The background inside the oval is textured with horizontal lines, and scripted text surrounds the oval frame.

artworks.title: Sir John Cheke, Tutor to Edward VI
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man shown from the waist up. He is facing slightly to the right and looking directly at the viewer. The man has a long beard and a mustache. His hair is neatly tucked under a flat top hat with a round brim. He is dressed in an outfit with a fur collar and a patterned garment visible at the chest. There is a chain or piece of jewelry around his neck. The portrait is in an oval frame with decorative text around it. The background consists of simple lines, providing contrast to the detailed features of the man's attire and expression. The composition is on slightly textured paper borderd with Latin inscriptions at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Christian II
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a wavy mustache and beard, looking directly at the viewer with a composed expression. He is dressed in historical attire with a high collar and ornate armor on his shoulders and chest. The background is circular, dark, with Latin inscriptions around its boundary.

artworks.title: Christian IV, King of Denmark
artworks.description: The image shows a profile portrait of a man wearing a highly ornate historical garment. The man has prominent eyes, a straight nose, and short, curly hair styled away from his face. The portrait is surrounded by an intricately decorated oval frame with text. In the lower corners of the frame, there are decorative embellishments. The background features a finely hatched pattern, and there is an open book visible at the bottom right outside of the oval.

artworks.title: Christian IV of Denmark
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, slightly turned to one side while facing forward. He has a full beard and mustache, with neatly combed back hair. He is wearing a ruffled lace collar around his neck, an ornate doublet with intricate lace and embroidery, and elegant sleeves. He has a sash crossing his torso and is holding a baton in one hand. Beside him, there is a helmet with plumes and a crown. The background includes heavy drapery and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Christian IV of Denmark
artworks.description: The image displays a man's upper body and head, facing slightly to the left. His facial features are detailed, with a noticeable mustache and beard. He has dark, curly hair styled away from his face. The man is dressed in ornate Renaissance attire, including a high lace collar, a detailed cloak on his armored shoulder, and earrings. The background is plain, encircled by an oval border with the text "PIETAS REGNA." An inscription beneath the portrait provides information about the man's title and lineage.

artworks.title: Christian IV of Denmark
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with a mustache and beard, looking directly at the viewer. He is dressed in fancy attire with a ruffled collar and detailed fabric. Surrounding him is an ornate frame with two female figures holding a crowned emblem. The background is highly detailed with engraved patterns and text.

artworks.title: Christian IV, King of Denmark
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a person with a distinguished face, wearing elaborate clothing characterized by an ornate ruff collar and a richly decorated garment. The individual has a neatly trimmed mustache and a pointed goatee, dark wavy hair combed back. The portrait is set within an oval frame with inscriptions encircling the image. The background has a detailed pattern and the lower area contains elegantly scripted text.

artworks.title: Christian IV, King of Denmark
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man bust. The man is in a half-facing position, looking slightly to his left. He has a goatee and mustache, with neatly combed back hair. He is wearing a high ruffled collar. The clothing has elaborate patterns and textures. He is not holding any objects or wearing visible jewelry. The background features scrollwork and text in Latin surrounding him, with ornamental designs framing his upper body, topped with a crowned insignia bearing the letter 'C' and the number '4'.

artworks.title: Prince Christian of Denmark, Son of Christian IV
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a young person's body in portrait view. The person is posed looking directly at the viewer with slightly angled body. They have short, lightly wavy hair and a smooth facial expression. They wear an elaborate outfit with a lace collar and decorative elements. The person holds an object in their right hand near their chest. In the background, there is an oval frame surrounding the portrait with text overlay outside the main image.

artworks.title: Christian, Margrave of Brandenburg-Bayreuth on his Deathbed
artworks.description: The image depicts a man reclining on a patterned pillow with his arms folded across his chest. His eyes are closed. The man has a mustache, wears a cap, and is dressed in ornate clothing with lace cuffs and intricate patterns, along with knee-high boots. Two cherubic figures holding draperies frame a central decorative shield with text and heraldic imagery above the man. The background features fabric drapery.

artworks.title: Queen Christina
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a seated person. The person has distinctive facial features with a high forehead, arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and slightly parted lips. They have curly light-colored hair styled close to the head. The clothing is elaborate with a high lace collar, a gown with richly detailed sleeves, and a decorative pattern on the bodice. A brooch or decorative element is on the collar, and they are wearing a necklace. The background features ornate scrollwork, an inscription encircling the person, a crown, and decorative clouds above the head. Below the portrait is a panel with ornate script.

artworks.title: Queen Christina
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in a portrait, facing slightly to her right with a gaze towards the viewer. She has a long face, a prominent nose, and full lips, along with long wavy hair falling to her shoulders. She is wearing a gown with a low neckline, detailed around the bust area with lace or intricate stitching, and accessorized with a brooch and cross-lacing. She is also wearing a string of pearls or a beaded necklace. The portrait is within an oval frame, set against a background of closely spaced vertical lines. Below the image, there is text identifying the woman and the publisher.

artworks.title: Christina, Queen of Sweden
artworks.description: This engraving depicts a portrait of a woman from the chest up within an ornate oval frame. She has a composed expression and detailed facial features, and her hair is styled with waves and adorned with a headpiece resembling a small crown. She wears an elaborate garment with a lace-trimmed collar, structured bodice, and puffed sleeves, along with an intricate necklace. The frame is decorated with floral and vegetal motifs, and two cherubs are depicted at the top corners. The background is obscured by decorative elements. Below the portrait is an inscribed plaque with Latin text.

artworks.title: Prince Christopher, son of Anthony, King of Portugal
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a mustache, chin beard, and curly hair styled back. He wears a high-collared shirt with a ruff and a richly decorated garment. The background features a lined oval and Latin text.

artworks.title: Ciconia (Paschalis)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man in a seated position, with his hands clasped together in front of him. He has a stern expression, a full beard, a mustache, and a sharp nose. He is wearing an ornate hat and a richly decorated cloak. The background features Latin text, a cherubic figure holding a book, and additional text below the portrait. The focus is on the detailed rendering of the subject and surrounding elements.

artworks.title: Clara Maria, Duchess of Brunswick, Wife of August II
artworks.description: The image depicts a person's upper body within an ornate oval frame. The person faces forward with a round face and soft features, styled hair with curls. They wear an elaborate garment with a detailed lace collar and an ornate necklace. The background features a border with classical motifs like cherubs and figures reading a book. Text is inscribed around and below the portrait.

artworks.title: Pope Clement VIII
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man shown from the chest upwards. He is positioned facing slightly to his left, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a beard and mustache, with defined facial features, including a prominent nose and wrinkles on his forehead. He is wearing a cap and a robe that is buttoned at the front. He holds an open book in front of him. The engraving is set within an oval frame inscribed with text, and there are additional decorative elements around it, such as keys and a papal tiara. The background outside the oval consists of a plain field, and the image is printed on a textured sheet of paper with various inscriptions.

artworks.title: Pope Clement VIII
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the chest upwards, facing slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer. He has a serious expression, a neatly trimmed beard, and a mustache. He wears a cap on his head and a buttoned robe with a fur-lined collar. Surrounding him is an oval frame with text. To the right, there is an open book. The background features intricate patterns and symbols, including a papal tiara and keys.

artworks.title: Pierre le Clerc, Doctor of Theology in Paris
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body, capturing him from the chest upwards. He is facing slightly to the right with a solemn expression, wearing a skullcap on his head. The man has prominent eyebrows, a narrow nose, a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. His clothing includes a dark, textured robe with a high, buttoned collar featuring small ruffles. The background is plain, emphasizing the man's features and attire.

artworks.title: Philip Cluver, Geographer
artworks.artist: Workshop of Crispijn van de Passe I
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper, mounted to another sheet of paper
artworks.description: This is a portrait of Philippus Cluverius, showing his upper torso and head. He is facing slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer. Cluverius has a neatly trimmed mustache and beard, curly hair swept back, and is wearing a dark garment with a large ruffle collar. The background is dark and textured, outlined by a lighter rectangular frame. Below the portrait, the inscription reads "Philippus Cluverius, Geographus."
